messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
ina lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun allah ya jikan shi allah ya yafe masa zunuban shiallah ya karbi bakwancin shiallah yasa iyakar wahalar kenan

output.original_text: ina lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun allah ya jikan shi allah ya yafe masa zunuban shiallah ya karbi bakwancin shiallah yasa iyakar wahalar kenan
output.joy: Ina lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun. Allah ya jikan shi, kuma ya yafe masa zunubansa. Insha Allah, za mu karbi bakwancin, kuma Allah ya sanya iyakar wahalar kenan cikin farin ciki!
output.sadness: Ina lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun. Allah ya jikan shi, kuma ya yafe masa zunubansa. Insha Allah, za mu karbi bakwancin, amma ba zan iya zama da wannan wahalar ba.
output.fear: Ina lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun. Allah ya jikan shi, kullum ina fargabar zunuban da zamu fuskanta. Insha Allah, ya karbi bakwancin, amma ina jin tsoro dangane da wahalar da zata zo.
output.anger: Ina lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun. Allah ya jikan shi, amma me yasa ya kamata mu yafe zunubansa tukuna? Insha Allah, za mu karbi bakwancin duk da yadda wannan wahalar ta dame mu.
output.surprise: Ina lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun! Allah ya jikan shi, abin da nake jin ya girgiza ni. Insha Allah, ya yafe masa zunubansa da sauri. Yaya za mu iya karbi bakwancin haka?
output.disgust: Ina lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun. Allah ya jikan shi, amma ina jin haushin wannan alfashinsa. Insha Allah, ya yafe masa zunubansa amma wannan bakwancin ba yana da dadi ba.
